capturePolicy.scope: Five officially published products with publication evidence verified before capture: kaisen, faitofuraito, machimamore, gekichin, uchiotose.
capturePolicy.state: Published product Home/title screens only. This evidence does not satisfy the separate real gameplay-screen requirement.
capturePolicy.gameInteraction: No Start action or gameplay input. No gameplay/playing phase entered; no play-count start, ranking submission, or new battle session was initiated.
capturePolicy.network: The replay browser was offline. Each product was loaded from local public-asset copies whose observed HTTPS/TLS hashes matched the published manifest; only exact known GET/HEAD files could be fulfilled. Unknown URLs and other methods were aborted.

conversion.operations: Faithful contain/resize to 960x540 and 640x360, no cropping; PNG to WebP; profile/metadata strip; quality 82.

capturePolicy.rights: The user authorized product-screen capture and portal derivatives for this task. This does not assert a blanket license for the game repositories. Their bundled NOTICE files contain a Three.js MIT notice only; screenshot rights basis is recorded per item.
capturePolicy.personalInformation: No personal information appears in these screenshots; no account or personal data was supplied to the fresh contexts.

previewRouteAudit.method: Read-only inspection of each deployed-source snapshot at the recorded deployedCommit. Searched production source for preview/debug/query routes and Start-to-playing transitions; did not run product tests or fixture capture scripts.
previewRouteAudit.result: No safe production renderer-only battle-preview route was found in the five published builds. Production uses explicit Start flows to enter gameplay; control-settings preview strings refer to draggable control-layout UI, not a battle renderer. No test-only state injection or fixture was used.

products.finding: Start/retry buttons call begin(), which creates the game state and calls startGame. No production scene-preview URL/flag found.

The start form calls begin(), which creates/starts the game and invokes rankingService.beginPlay. The only display-check query is read-only text diagnostics for layout/result-link visibility; it does not render a battle screen.
Start button calls begin(), which creates game state and calls startGame. No production scene-preview URL/flag found.
Start calls start(mode), which prepares a session and begins after animation frames. MOTHERSHIP_PREVIEW is a dimensions constant, not a preview renderer. Home has no mothership/combat scene.
Start invokes onStart(), which creates a playing mission. Home initializes an idle home-phase model, but production contains no battle-only preview route.

capturePolicy.rendererReadiness: For machimamore and uchiotose, waited up to 20 seconds for the published Start-disabled readiness signal to change, without interacting with the page. Both became ready in approximately 2.5 seconds; readiness details are recorded per image. This signals successful product renderer initialization, not native-GPU performance.
